rationale: Phase 4 Track 1 diagnostic: trend_vol got long=0 in ALL 4 windows including 2 confirmed bull markets. Manually recomputed tv_long conditions on raw BTC 1h data for bull_2024Q4: 392/2208 candles satisfy close>ema50 & ema_rising & vol_expanding & rsi<75 (healthy). Regime gate is 100% NEUTRAL/BULL/EUPHORIA for the whole window (never blocks longs). So do_predict (DI/SVM outlier filter) is the only remaining candidate for suppressing every long entry. This run disables both filters (filter_di=False, filter_svm=False) to test that directly, isolating whether DI/SVM is systematically flagging EUPHORIA/strong-trend candles as outliers.
